params.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

search_parameters.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

text_blocks.snippet: The standard Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transaction limit per day depends on the type of transaction and the category of the merchant:

list.snippet: General Transactions (P2P & P2M): The standard maximum limit is ₹1,00,000 per day (and per transaction), typically capped at a maximum of 20 transactions per day.

Special Categories (Higher Limits): For specific verified merchant categories—such as hospitals, educational institutions, tax payments, capital markets/insurance, and IPO applications—the limit is extended up to ₹5,00,000 per transaction.
Feature Phones (UPI 123Pay): Restricted to ₹10,000 per transaction.

text_blocks.snippet: Note: Individual banks and specific UPI applications (like Google Pay, PhonePe, or BHIM) may enforce stricter internal limits or lower daily caps depending on your account type.
If you want, I can help you check the specific limit for your bank or let you know how to set up a task to track any future changes to NPCI guidelines.

response.reconstructed_markdown:
The standard Unified Payments Interface \(UPI\) transaction limit per day depends on the type of transaction and the category of the merchant:

- General Transactions \(P2P & P2M\): The standard maximum limit is ₹1,00,000 per day \(and per transaction\), typically capped at a maximum of 20 transactions per day. [0]
- Special Categories \(Higher Limits\): For specific verified merchant categories—such as hospitals, educational institutions, tax payments, capital markets/insurance, and IPO applications—the limit is extended up to ₹5,00,000 per transaction. [0] [1]
- Feature Phones \(UPI 123Pay\): Restricted to ₹10,000 per transaction. [1]

Note: Individual banks and specific UPI applications \(like Google Pay, PhonePe, or BHIM\) may enforce stricter internal limits or lower daily caps depending on your account type. [1] [2]

If you want, I can help you check the specific limit for your bank or let you know how to set up a task to track any future changes to NPCI guidelines.
